## Before sharing

This report is optional. GitHub issues are public and require a GitHub account.
Use only the supplied fictional exercise files or a small invented reproduction.
Do not paste real calendars, UIDs, titles, attendees, file paths containing personal
information, credentials, or reports from real exports. Review every field before
submitting. You can stop the exercise without submitting anything.
